laws.rule: Manuel Antonio: open Wednesday to Monday 7 am to 3 pm (closed Tuesday); tickets online only. Non-resident adults US$18.08 (about A$25.68 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children 2 to 12 US$5.65 (about A$8.03 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Food/drink entry is subject to the administration's conditions and exceptions; food service and consumption are confined to the concession area, with no food on beaches or trails. No pets, alcohol consumption, smoking, drugs, umbrellas, balls, tents or hammocks; do not feed wildlife. Showers must not be used with soap or shampoo.
laws.heading: Parque Nacional Manuel Antonio

laws.rule: Corcovado: entry only with a local guide registered with ACOSA; bookings up to six months ahead, personal and non-transferable, passport shown at entry. Non-resident adults US$16.95 (about A$24.08 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children US$5.65 (about A$8.03 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). No swimming in beaches, lagoons or rivers, no alcohol or drugs, no leaving trails; breaches mean expulsion and a report to authorities.
